# BMNova

> BMNova builds user-friendly AI apps, mobile products, and SaaS tools.

Website: https://bmnova.com
Contact: hello@bmnova.com
Blog: https://bmnova.com/blog

## Products

- [DietPal](https://bmnova.com/projects/dietpal): AI diet tracking, meal plans, and coaching. Photo/text food logging, personalized plans, progress charts.
- [FitVibe](https://bmnova.com/projects/fitvibe): AI digital wardrobe and stylist. Closet logging with background removal, outfit combines, wardrobe gaps, virtual try-on.
- [RoomPace](https://bmnova.com/projects/roompace): Budget-aware AI interior design. Upload a room photo, set a spend limit, get layouts and a shoppable furniture wishlist.
- [Haki](https://bmnova.com/projects/haki): AI manga comics generator. Script stories, define characters, generate comic panels.
- [Offer](https://bmnova.com/projects/offer): Social icebreaker app. Offer drinks or snacks at local businesses to connect with people nearby.
- [NextStep](https://bmnova.com/projects/nextstep): Minimalist AI coaching for overthinking. One reflection, one question, one clear next step.
- [Bloomish](https://bmnova.com/projects/bloomish): AI bouquet generator for sending digital flower gifts.
- [intyx.ai](https://intyx.ai): CSV to AI dashboards — upload data, get interactive charts in seconds.
- [dynamic.intyx.ai](https://dynamic.intyx.ai): Real-time Flutter content updates without shipping a new app build.

## Partner work

- [Pixvibe](https://www.everpixel.org/apps/pixvibe): AI photo editing (built with EverPixel)
- [Collagevibe](https://www.everpixel.org/apps/collagevibe): Photo collages (built with EverPixel)
